subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: How should the session workspace rail represent transcript-touched paths that exist but are directories, outside the workspace root, or rejected by fs-safe symlink containment?
rationale: The remaining fix can either hide/relabel external or non-file entries or expose metadata deliberately; automation should not choose that workspace boundary policy for maintainers.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: Filter or neutrally label outside-root/fs-safe-rejected entries while preserving the existing contained workspace file metadata boundary.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: Allow existence/size/mtime for transcript-mentioned external paths only with explicit maintainer approval, tests, and documentation of the boundary.

options.title: Split UI And Backend Work
options.body: Carry only any remaining layout/root display fix now and leave external/directory Missing semantics for a separate boundary decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: Filter or neutrally label outside-root/fs-safe-rejected entries while preserving the existing contained workspace file metadata boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing and file preview work makes this the strongest available owner for the fs-safe metadata boundary choice.
